value.0: A trial altar on the west side of the crypt, its offerings looted and its carvings chipped by blaster fire. The crypt raiders' captain keeps watch over it.
A trial altar on the east side of the crypt, stained dark around its base. The Vitae Reavers' enforcer guards it like a feeding ground.
A trial altar in the north-west of the crypt, half buried under umbral raider gear and forged orders. Their captain claims it as his post.
